in_sanskrit.name: Gutam
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Knowledge, Wisdom
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Gutam एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Gutam is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Gudh’ which means 'that which is hidden'. The name Gutam is a masculine name and is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Gudhatma’, which means 'one who holds knowledge within himself'. This name symbolizes wisdom and knowledge that is deeply rooted within an individual.
